errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the chart has a split Y-axis with two different scales (one on the left from 15% to 45% and one on the right from 45% to 65%). It describes it as a single continuous axis.

errors.text_span: етикетите са разположени на равномерни интервали от 5%
errors.evidence: The Y-axis does not have uniform 5% intervals. The left part of the axis has major tick marks at 10% intervals (15%, 25%, 35%, 45%), and the right part has major tick marks at 4% intervals (45%, 49%, 53%, 57%, 61%, 65%).
The description states that the blue line for 'потребителски стоки' ends at 28% in 2017. The chart shows this value is exactly at the 25% tick mark.

errors.text_span: след което има плавно нарастване до 2017 година
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue line for 'потребителски стоки' smoothly increases until 2017. The chart shows that after peaking in 2016, the line slightly decreases in 2017.

errors.text_span: след което има лек спад до 2017 година
errors.evidence: The description states that the red line for 'инвестиционни стоки' has a slight drop to 2017. The chart clearly shows that the red line continuously increases from 2008 to 2017, with no drop at the end.

The description states that the green line for 'суровини, материали и енергийни ресурси' ends at 48% in 2017. This is a severe misreading; the line ends at approximately 22%, which is clearly below the 25% mark on the left-hand scale. The model seems to have incorrectly read the value against the right-hand scale.

errors.text_span: Тя показва спад от 41% през 2008 г. до 27% през 2011 г., последван от нарастване до 36% през 2012 г., след което има рязък спад до 2013 г. и отново плавно нараства до 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The entire description of the trend for the green line is incorrect. For example, it claims a drop to 27% in 2011, but the chart shows a peak at around 39% in 2011. It then claims an increase to 2012, but the chart shows a decrease. The overall trend from 2011 to 2016 is a steady decrease, not the fluctuating pattern described.
The initial value for the blue line in 2008 is closer to 23%, but 24% is a reasonable approximation.
The final value for the red line in 2017 is described as 24%. The line actually ends exactly on the 25% tick mark.
The initial value for the green line in 2008 is described as 41%. The line starts slightly below the midpoint between 35% and 45%, making the value closer to 39%.
